chains.name: Subway
chains.src: Subway UK & ROI Nutrition Information, November 2026 (checked 2026-11-22), per serving as listed. Subs, wraps and toasties are bread, protein, onions, cucumbers and lettuce, with no cheese or sauce unless named; footlongs are double the 6-inch, as Subway says. Footlong pizzas are the whole pizza. Ingredients (breads, proteins, cheese, sauces) are add-ons. Left out 2: Loaded Waffle Fries (Fajita) (same figures as Mac & Cheese (Fajita), a copy slip); Peppered Cheese (ROI) (Ireland only). kJ left blank where Subway's kJ doesn't match its kcal (the kcal matches the macros): Mac & Cheese (Classic), Mac & Cheese (American Hot), Mac & Cheese (Steak), Mac & Cheese (Fajita). Subway lists allergens per ingredient, not per sub, so none are given here. (22 Nov 2026)

chains.name: Five Guys
chains.src: Five Guys UK Allergen, Ingredient & Nutrition Guide, UK locations only (dated 13 October 2026; checked 2026-11-22), per serving as listed; serving weights are worked out from the per-100 g column. Milkshakes are the base plus whipped cream and mix-ins, each listed on its own. Breakfast items are Heathrow only. Left out 3: Flake (43 kcal, macros add up to 184); Little Bacon Burger (537 kcal, macros add up to 1823); Americano White (no figures). Allergens from the guide's grid; 'may' is Five Guys' 'not suitable due to manufacturing and preparation' mark. (22 Nov 2026)

chains.name: LEON
chains.src: leon.co menu item nutrition and allergens (2026-11-22), per item as served; LEON publishes kcal only. Left out 12: 9 with no nutrition (crisps, snacks, teas, retail coffee), the Kids Pick and Mix meal, and 2 of 60 kcal or more whose kcal is over a third away from their macros (Mushroom Magic Romesco, White Chocolate & Cranberry Matcha). LEON gives no may-contain list. (22 Nov 2026)

chains.name: Costa Coffee
chains.src: costa.co.uk menu nutrition and allergens (2026-11-22). Drinks are takeaway, one row per size, with Costa's default milk (semi-skimmed for most), blend and topping, as named in each serve. Left out 6: Ferrero Rocher - 3 Pieces (no figures); Popchips Barbeque (no figures); Bounce Peanut Protein Ball (no figures); Tyrrells Lightly Sea Salted (no figures); Tyrrells Mature Cheddar & Chive (no figures); Tyrrells Sea Salt & Cider Vinegar (no figures). 'May' is Costa's cross-contamination risk. (22 Nov 2026)

chains.name: itsu
chains.src: itsu.com product pages, UK menu (2026-11-22), per item as sold; itsu publishes kcal only. Sushi figures leave out the bottle of soy sauce, as itsu says. Left out 22: 2 alcoholic drinks, 0 with no figures, 19 milk coffees and matcha lattes that itsu lists without the milk, 1 of 60 kcal or more whose kcal is over a third away from their macros (Miso with Benefits (83 kcal, macros 136)). Allergens and may-contain are itsu's own lists. (22 Nov 2026)
